categories.UAP_PRIMARY: official release or archive, not necessarily verified measurement
categories.MEASUREMENT_CONTROL: public instrument data for controls, not by itself UAP
categories.INDEPENDENT_CONTEXT: independent context with case-specific space-time coverage
categories.ACCESS_REQUEST: conditional access, no acquisition without approval

rules: Never equate event date with release date; preserve original date string and uncertainty.
No real timing conflict without authenticated emitter and receiver, path lower bound, calibrated clocks and uncertainties, signal front and common event identity.
No physical tachyon attribution without exclusive calibrated carrier response and independent evidence.
Duplicate releases, mirrors and multiple statements are not independent physical events.
No private witness details or unauthorized/restricted acquisition. No bulk copying protected narrative text; retain metadata, links, numeric control data and hashes.
No live operational tracking. Historical matching only; current rolling environmental data used as a control.
A missing record does not exclude a conventional explanation; assess archive coverage.
Record failures and contradictory counts; do not choose a convenient total.
admission.native_retina: HOLD unless ON/OFF/REPEAT_ON/REPEAT_OFF role contract or separately validated modality adapter

notes: Web results had inconsistent snapshot dates. Official PURSUE portal direct HTTP403; archive machine export not downloaded by browser in this turn; counts 521 and 524 differ among mirrors.
PURSUE R08 reported 43 items; no claim that all primary bytes were downloaded. Acquisition workflow verifies actual bytes and manifest contents separately.
Open access does not imply public domain or unrestricted reuse; use provider-specific terms. No contact with custodians initiated.
